Known for its vibrant orange and navy colors, the club was established in 1990 as [[İstanbul Büyükşehir Belediyespor]] and separated its football activities in the year 2014 from the municipality and competes in the top tier of Turkish football, the [[Süper Lig]].{{cite web|url=http://www.sporx.com/futbol/superlig/istanbulbb/super-ligin-yeni-takimi-basaksehir-SXHBQ388848SXQ |title=Süper Lig'in yeni takımı Başakşehir|date=5 June 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140606130745/http://www.sporx.com/futbol/superlig/istanbulbb/super-ligin-yeni-takimi-basaksehir-SXHBQ388848SXQ |access-date=26 June 2026 |archive-date=6 June 2014 }} The team plays its home matches at the [[Başakşehir Fatih Terim Stadium]], which has been their base since 2014. The club achieved its first league championship in the [[2019–20 Süper Lig|2019–20 season]], marking a milestone in its relatively young history.{{cite web|url=https://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=1501 |title=Ligler » Trendyol Süper Lig » 2019-2020 Sezonu Süper Lig Fikstürü ve Puan Cetveli|website=Tff.org|access-date=26 June 2026}} Başakşehir continues to participate in various domestic and international tournaments, including the [[Turkish Cup]], [[UEFA Champions League]], [[UEFA Europa League]] and [[UEFA Conference League]], showcasing its ambition to become a consistent contender in Turkish and European football."}}
